app.name: MediCompare
app.tagline: Understand medicine prices. Discuss options with your doctor or pharmacist.
app.notice: Information only, not medical advice. MediCompare does not sell or prescribe medicines.
app.footer: Payments and partnerships never influence results. In an emergency, call 112.

options.jaHelp: Listed separately. A listing does not confirm that a Kendra has it. Check with the Kendra before you travel.

about.title: About MediCompare
about.body: MediCompare helps you understand medicine prices in India. Every price shows its type, source and date.
about.isNot: MediCompare is not a pharmacy, seller, prescriber, diagnostic tool, dosing or interaction advisor, teleconsultation service or emergency service.
about.neutral: Payments and partnerships never influence how results are ranked.
about.data: Ceiling prices are reproduced from the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), Government of India. Brand products, shop prices and Jan Aushadhi entries in this version are Demo data.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.minimal: Search works without an account and without storing your searches.
privacy.images: Prescription images are private. Photo metadata such as GPS location is removed, and images are deleted automatically after the retention period.
privacy.rights: You can delete any upload, export your data as JSON and delete your account from the account page.
privacy.ai: Text in uploaded files is treated as data, never as instructions. Optional external AI processing is off by default.
